notes.title: Mushroots Update
notes.content: Fixed a bug related to the leaderboard

notes.title: Update 1.4 - ARCADE MODE
notes.content:
Arcade
Arcade hits Mushroots 1.4, our biggest update since launch into early access. 

[previewyoutube=3lHa3iDCN_w;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve poured countless hours into crafting the new Tower of Progress—a pulse-pounding gauntlet of increasingly challenging floors. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/ed4baf8b1bf9e5ea8d2f713ff2382d3ad0f06156.gif

You can tackle it with up to three friends, forging a fearless team as you climb higher. Each stage ups the ante, testing your reflexes, wits, and—occasionally—your patience. 

Feeling extra brave? Try the single-life mode and see if you’ve got what it takes to secure a spot on the leaderboards.

Other changes
PvE
Meanwhile, PvE lets you pick a side for fresh spawns and fun co-op moments. 

Team colors
Brand-new team colors to keep things clear. 

Balance

 Base build range: 5 → 4 (min), 13 → 12 (max)
 Simple mushroom build range: 7 → 6 (max)
 Defender build time: 12 → 1
 Rig cost: 50 → -150 (partial refund on evolution)
 Attacker range: 6 → 10, attack cost: 150 → 250, build cost: 300 → 200
 Bomb cost: 500 → 400
 Dirty Bomb cost: 100 → 50

Bug fix

 Sync fix
 UI fix
 Match connect fix
 End game fix

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have some news to share with you:

🔥50% Discount!🔥
We are offering a special 50% discount on Mushroots. It's a great chance to join the game or invite your friends and play together.

Price Increase in the Future 
As promised, we want to inform you in advance that the game's price will increase in the future. 

Revamped Online Matches 
We have focused on enhancing your gaming experience. This update includes a global rework of the online matchmaking system and fixes for multiple synchronization issues. Playing with friends has never been better!

What's Next? A New Game Mode! 
In the next update, we will introduce a new game mode – Arcade! Stay tuned for more details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/b3f917f2586be3eb7f81a4597798585f2edee420.png

Thank you for staying with us and supporting the development of Mushroots. We continue to work on improving the game!

notes.title: Mushroots Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of Update 1.3, packed with exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience!

New Maps
Labyrinth (1x1): Get ready to navigate the twisting paths of the Labyrinth. This compact map offers intense, close-quarters gameplay where every turn could lead to treasure or danger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/ba0432be16bda36e539a29ce634e671ed2755af6.png

Ancient Forest (2x2): Prepare to explore the vast and mysterious Ancient Forest. With its sprawling layout, you must strategize and cooperate with your team to conquer this challenging terrain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/650a4be37617e88d2554a3ae3c4fa8ff6fa448da.png

Help Button
We’ve listened to your feedback and are excited to introduce the much-anticipated Help Button. This new feature will provide comprehensive in-game assistance, making it easier to navigate and master Mushroots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/691427ffcdb2b2382af30f56d0efedb87fe02f97.png

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for 6/8/2024
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with crashing in 2v2 mode.
 Improved the ranges indicator.

notes.title: About 1.2.0
notes.content:
Another update for our game is here! It brings a host of minor changes that will enhance your gameplay experience.

New Minimap
With the new minimap, you'll gain even more control over the situation on the battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/42f3d08711b2265b8e5b022bd6c1ecddde65fb8d.png
You can now adjust the visible area size using your mouse wheel and navigate by clicking on the map.

Building Zone
Building has become much more convenient! You no longer need to calculate everything manually—a beautiful pink contour will highlight the permissible construction area.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/abe9c9393e56fef78e0e635a505346d6808bf2ba.png
Also, the attack range and explosion radii are now displayed.

Look Here!
Playing with a partner has gotten easier, thanks to the new pointer system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/138aaa367a1b94cad1347f4cbde1424f9c1871f1.png
Pressing the Shift+Click on the map or minimap will now leave an icon that helps indicate an important area on the battlefield to your ally.

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon.

notes.title: Achievements unlocked: Create achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to share our latest achievements with you! In just a short time since the release of Mushroots, we are thrilled to announce a major update. In version 1.1.0, we have introduced numerous new achievements that you can already start unlocking!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831699/8fd6f34ea9c9c7eb2d911f860d06ecfe4c4fddb1.png

Additionally, we have made balance adjustments and fixed some errors. Enjoy the update, and stay tuned for even more exciting news from us!

Balance
We have focused on the view radius of mushrooms. Now, their teamwork is even more crucial for achieving success.

Base:
↑ Spore recharge time reduced from 30 to 20s
↓ View decreased from 16 to 14 tile

Attacker:
↓ View decreased from 6 to 3 tile

Blob:
↓ View decreased from 6 to 2 tile

Bomb:
↓ View decreased from 6 to 2 tile

Dirty bomb:
↓ View decreased from 6 to 2 tile

Defender:
↑ Minimum building radius decreased from 3 to 2 tile

Maps
Citadel (2x2)

 minor adjustments made

Other

 various errors fixed

notes.title: AND WE START!
notes.content:
Exciting Announcement: Mushroots Game Release!

Hey gamers,

We've got some great news to share! After a lot of hard work, we've finally finished developing our game, Mushroots. It's been quite a journey from its beginnings at a game jam to now, spanning over two years of effort.

Mushroots, our real-time strategy game, will be available to play starting May 1st of this year. We're really looking forward to hearing your thoughts, feedback, and any ideas you might have for new features. And of course, if you encounter any bugs or unbalanced mechanics, please let us know so we can fix them.

But most importantly, we hope you'll have a lot of fun playing the game! Don't forget to join our Discord channel for more updates and to connect with other players: Mushroots Discord

Happy gaming!
